create_pytorch_dataloader: create a PyTorchDataLoader from a map-style dataset using get_pytorch_dataloader with batch_size and shuffle options
iterate_dataloader: iterate over batches from a PyTorchDataLoader by calling its __iter__ method in a for loop
get_dataloader_length: get the number of batches in a PyTorchDataLoader by calling len on the dataloader instance
serialize_dataset_to_shmem: serialize a PyTorch dataset into shared memory using _serialize_dataset for fast worker initialization
resolve_sampler_and_collate: resolve sampler, fetch function, and collate function using _resolve_sampler given batch_size and shuffle parameters
